lines.speaker: News Reporter
lines.text: Over the last 13 hours, more than two dozen evacuation orders have been issued all over the globe.

lines.speaker: News Reporter
lines.text: Thousands upon millions head for the countryside, including the endangered Saskatoad T-rexes; while others seek shelter.

lines.speaker: News Reporter
lines.text: The world has never seen terror as real as it has today.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You're kidding me...

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Yeah, right? Dinosaurs are still a thing. It's odd how we never talk about it.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: At least not since we drove them out of the cities.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'm talking about terror!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: "Never seen," my ass; my Dad released every murderer out onto the streets and overthrew the world government!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Oh, right; and the king of the world is a blue Cairn Terrier.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: It's bullshit!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: I think it's pretty progressive.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Awwww, look at the poor Namekian, lost and forgotten to time.

lines.speaker: News Reporter
lines.text: Even the attack of the Saiyans five years ago pales in comparison to this overwhelming threat, as if comparing a cataclysm to a rampaging toddler.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Bullshit! We turned an entire city into a glass floor!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Awwww, look at the poor Saiyan, lost and forgotten to time.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *Watch it*, Namekian; unless you want to go right now, and I think we both know how our last fight went.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: And *I* think we don't, because we've never fought.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I... wait... y-- really? But then how did you--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Your dumbass friend.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Riiight! Wow, we've never actually fought, that's so weird.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Isn't that weird, black man?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Yeah! Almost as weird as what's gonna happen if you call me that again!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'What is he...?'
They all sense Goku and Gohan's ki

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright now, Gohan. When you get out there, try not to brag.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That's it, son. Don't let slip just how much stronger we are.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Otherwise, Vegeta will be all, "OH, BUT MY PRIDE, GRR, I WISH I WERE A CARROT".

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: That's not *in*accurate...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Piccolo will probably just growl and grumble; really, it's too bad we're out of Namekians for him to absorb, then he'd be as strong as Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Growling to himself)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Speaking of, did you know they've never fought? Crazy, right!?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, hey guys, what'd I miss?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Mock my pride...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh, what'd I tell you? He's like a See-n'-Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'MA KILL HIM!
♫ "Cha-La Head-Cha-La" ♫
♫ CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA ♫
♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)
♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)
♫ Sparking! [fading echo] ♫
(Subbed by Hideo Kojima)

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Soooo...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Was there enough food in there?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Did you get stronger?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Mmhm!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Stronger than Cell?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hmmmmmmm...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: For the love of-- swallow! Now!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...I'm not pooping tonight.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ARE YOU STRONGER THAN CELL?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'ma need my threads first.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yo, Mr. P! Hit me up!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Bitch, you're lucky you're endearing.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Another reason I want to kill Son Goku? He is so orange.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: It's like - come on... there are other colors.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Am I right?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So we'll have to machine the skull ourselves...

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Another reason to kill Son Goku, you ask?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: His stupid face.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Have you seen it?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yeeeep.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: That's a face even a mother could kill.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Now luckily, Dad has enough synthetic skin to patch that area.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Another reason to kill Son Goku is--

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey... so, how about we talk about something else?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: What is your favorite type of bird?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, umm...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Penguins.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: WRONG!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ahhh, good ol' orange. Really brings out my stupid face.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: I had them washed for you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Aww, man! Now they don't have that "Goku" smell.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey Gohan! We'll have your Mom make you a new Gi when we get home.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You're probably too big for your old one now.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I've got it covered.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Uh... Mr. Piccolo? Could you... uhh...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: What, you want you to make you a Gi like your dad's?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, I was hoping I could get one like yours?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Did our heart just skip a beat?'

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: 'That is precious.'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Shut. The F***. Up!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, sure. I guess.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: CLOTHES BEAM!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow... you know, that works on you. I mean, if you don't like orange...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Quick rundown:

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: (Happily chuckling to himself)

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Doors are going to be a little difficult at first; I suggest a 45° angle.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: (Sigh)

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Also; crowds. But I don't really deal with them...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Look, I don't mean to be *that* guy...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh, that's "accidental".

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...*but*, there's a green cyborg elephant in the room.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Goku... are you or are you not stronger than Cell?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'll go check!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm sorry; go check wha--?
POP

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Look, I understand that you sponsor all forms of sporting events... but just so we're clear, you *do* realize that everyone dies if I win, right?

lines.speaker: HETAP Rep
lines.text: Yeah, but if you think about it, you kill us, and it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: HETAP Rep
lines.text: Basically it's a total win-win for us either way.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yeah, I guess that is a win-win for you, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Alright then! It's officially "The Cell Games: Presented by HETAP"!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'd kill for a HETAP!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: WHOA, JESUS!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No, actually. It's Goku.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Need to put a bell on you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Nothing! Sorry, I just wasn't expecting you for another *week*! (Chuckles) Must look a mess...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I just got done finishing the ring, patching a hole... Speaking of which!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: What do you think of our glorious battleground? (Chuckles)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Eh, s'alright. Kinda small, innit?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I prefer... *intimate*.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, I'm not intimidated either.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Ohh, but you should be!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because in it - we shall decide the fate of not only this boring blue ball of dirt and water, but the *entire galaxy*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So you best bring your A-game, Son Goku.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because the stakes... have never been higher! (Chuckles)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (Gasp!)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And before you say it, the prize isn't actually steak.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I wasn't thinking that.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes you were.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then WHAT is the prize, you *monster*?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Living!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Also, a lifetime supply of HETAP!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Y'know, they say "lifetime", but they never consider the Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Anyway, I just came to measure you up.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And I gotta say... nice.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Baby, you know it.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I've seen all I need.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now, I'm off to go and have a... high-fiber dinner...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: See you in a week!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: It's a date...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah... I know...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That's how days work.
POP

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: ...I'm gonna miss him when he's dead.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So the Androids took my arm?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Yeah; you lost it saving my life.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, did it at least look cool?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, man, it was the COOLEST!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You were always the first to jump in a battle... and you never backed down... and you saved my life SO many times!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I died, didn't I?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Brutally...
POP

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow, okay, yeah, he's pretty strong...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Also, really handsome... Like, why did none of you warn me he would be so handsome?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: But is he *stronger* than *you*?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If he's as strong as he is handsome, then OH-HO BOY.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I mean, I'd never cheat on Chi-Chi, but...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So handsome...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well then, if it's all the same to you, I'ma take my turn inside the chamber.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, maybe after you're done, you and 'Geets can finally have a go.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Go easy on him, best buddy.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...You know, I was stronger than you yesterday.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, but that was a year ago... we've *all* grown!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Like Gohan! Just look at him! All super, and Saiyan...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: About that!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You've been Super Saiyan since you came out. What's up with that?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, after extended exposure and focus, our bodies acclimated to the elevated state.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We can sustain it without literally any loss in stamina!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: WHAT?! >:O

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yuh-huh! Also, we kinda forgot how to turn it off. Ha-ha-ha...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Truthfully, it's very concerning.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, for *Cell*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And, uh, also doors...

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: *What did you do*?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: See you at "The Cell Games: Presented by HETAP"!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'That hollow-skulled bastard, now I'm angry AND thirsty!'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: BOY!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We're going back in the chamber and fixing this immediately!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Yeah, Piccolo just went in.
SLAM

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Wha-ugh... Then what the hell am I supposed to do for 24 hours?! Hang out with you two idiots?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Fine. Your literal humanity disgusts me, anyway.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Guess it's just you and me now, black man.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: (Sigh)

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH...!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: See? I told you it would happen.

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: T'was never a matter of if...

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: (Sip)
BOOOM

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: only when.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Crazy, you're both like a year older now, huh?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yuh-huh! Which means he's TEEN Gohan, now!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, I'm 11, so that means that I'm a pre--

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That means *you* need a BIRTHDAY PARTY!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ooo! Can it be Super Saiyan themed?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: (Gasp) With little spiky pieces of yellow frosting?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That sounds amazing...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Chi-Chi! Super Saiyan Cake me!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: ...Goku?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Did you take our son into a magical reality outside of spacetime, for an entire *year*, bleach his hair without my consent, and suddenly come back home demanding *birthday cake*?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If it makes you feel any better, it's not bleach...

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: It doesn't.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Are you upset?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: No... because I know how you're going to pay me back.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Mom, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Krillin... would you take Gohan out for a few hours?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, we're going to Kame House.
Krillin and Gohan run off into the distance

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait, what does she mean?! Guys?!?
Door closing

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: He said one week... and I'm using it.
Closed

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wha... what are you--

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: [Repetitive / agressive grunting]

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *HUUUUUUUUUUUUUU*--?!
♫ Closing theme (DBZ intermission) ♫

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: 'Seriously... you can materialize clothing from your very being.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'You wouldn't have to spend *anything* on supplies, manufacturing...'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'I am focusing on training!'

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: 'You *should* be focusing on what you're going to do after Cell is defeated.'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Fine, but what would we even call this hypothetical clothing line of ours?'

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: '"Big Green Threads"'.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: '"Big Green Threads"'.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...We might need to workshop that.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I think it has a *perfect* ring to it.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, well, you're big and green! You have a bias!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Wait, are we hallucinating?'

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: 'How long have we been in here?'

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Three days.
SLAM

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'm out!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I CALL DIBS!

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: Hey, everyone. I'm Lanipator, co-writer and co-star of DBZA, and I wanted to thank you for watching.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: If you enjoyed what you saw, let us know by leaving a comment and clicking that little thumbs up icon.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: And if you're new here and want to stay up-to-date on everything we have coming down the pipeline, then be sure to click that Subscribe button as well.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: If you haven't had enough anime parody goodness just yet, then may I recommend checking out our friend, LittleKuriboh?

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: I'm sure a lot of you already know him, but for those that don't, he's the guy that started this whole abridged series craze, and we wouldn't be here without him, so show him some love!

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: Also, if you want to hang out with us tonight, ask some questions about the episode or have any question in general, why not join our livestream that kicks off at 6 P.M. Central Standard Time tonight as we play some DragonBall Fusions.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: If you're catching this after the fact, don't worry. Not only will the archives still exist if you want to check it out, but we also stream nearly every Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday over on TFS Gaming.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: So come on by and join us! Come on! It's my birthday. L-literally it's... it's my birthday. September 28th...

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: Love you guys!
